verdict.rationale: Wise Business docs show a genuinely consolidated feature set spanning banking (multi-currency accounts holding 56 currencies, statements, FDIC passthrough insurance), spend (card issuance, spend controls, MCC rules), and bill pay/payments (batch transfers, direct debit funding, webhooks, delivery estimates) all under one API/account, supporting the founder narrative of replacing multiple point tools with one platform. Missing for 10: independent third-party case studies or reviews confirming founders actually consolidated spend/bill pay/banking tools onto Wise Business, and clearer resolution of community-reported account stability/category-mismatch issues that could undercut trust in using it as a sole banking platform.
